script.source: m164, the game's own AI script, read by the RE session (review of 2026-10-14); numbers only
turn: gauge >= 100: Energy Blast on all, gauge and Rays fired reset
else gauge >= 60 and fewer than 2 Rays fired: Energy Ray
else gauge >= 30 and 0 Rays fired: Energy Ray
else gauge + 5, then random() % 3: 0 Sonic Wings, 1 or 2 Attack

rng.random: stream 2, one draw per attack-class turn only
